{{Top|leg}}
The '''scientist-philosophers''' were the leaders of the [[Oblee]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Oblis]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. Thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Unidentified wandering trader|wandering traveler]] brought the [[Darkstaff]], a dangerous [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]], to Oblis. The scientist-philosophers evntually obtained and studied the object, and they recognized that the staff was a source of great power. However, the Darkstaff began manipulating the Oblee and it summoned a [[shadow creature]] to Oblis, then led the scientist-philosophers to believe that the creature posed a threat to the Oblee. The scientist-philosophers determined to used the Darkstaff to power a machine that would allow them to send the shadow creature away from the Cularin system and to power the machine, they created three focusing [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]], into which all of the Oblee channeled their hopes and fears. The scientist-philsophers then placed the Darkstaff inside the machine, resulting in a [[Destruction of Oblis|large cataclysm]] that destroyed Oblis and transformed the scientist-philosophers and the rest of the Oblee into incorporeal beings known as "shadow lurkers."
